info.title: avro-sg
info.description: Generate C# models from Avro schemas, protocols, and IDL on demand.

commands.name: compile
commands.description: Generate C# models from Avro schemas, protocols, and IDL.

options.name: --library
options.description: Runtime library. Chr support was removed in 0.8.0. Auto requires a consuming compilation. Values: None, Apache, Chr, Auto. [default: None]

options.name: --language-version
options.description: C# syntax ceiling: 7.3, 8 through 15, or preview. [default: 14]

options.name: --language-features
options.description: Language feature preset or comma-separated flags, capped by the C# version. Values: None, CSharp7_3, CSharp8, NullableReferenceTypes, Records, CSharp9, InitOnlyProperties, CSharp10, RequiredProperties, RawStringLiterals, CSharp11, UnsafeAccessors, CSharp12, CSharp13, CSharp14, Unions, All, CSharp15, Latest. [default: CSharp15]

options.name: --preview-features
options.description: Preview feature opt-ins. Values: None, Unions. [default: None]

options.name: --access-modifier
options.description: Generated type visibility. Values: Public, Internal. [default: Public]

options.name: --record-declaration
options.description: Generate record or class declarations when supported. [default: record]

options.name: --reference-resolution
options.description: Named reference resolution. Values: Strict, Deferred. [default: Strict]

options.name: --duplicate-resolution
options.description: Duplicate declaration handling; Ignore keeps the first definition. Values: Error, Ignore. [default: Error]

options.name: --force
options.description: Allow replacement of existing generated files. [default: False]

options.name: --check
options.description: Check expected files without writing. Extra files are ignored. [default: False]

arguments.name: INPUTS
arguments.description: Avro files, recursive directories, or quoted glob patterns, in declaration precedence order.
